text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Planning (Child Care Centre — Authorisation) Notification.

heading.en: Authorisation of change in use to child care centre

text.en:
3. Subject to paragraphs 4 and 4A and any other written law, any change in use of any premises specified in the First Schedule (referred to in this Notification as the relevant premises) to a use as a child care centre is hereby authorised.
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]

4A. The authorisation under paragraph 3 shall cease to apply if any condition of authorisation referred to in paragraph 4 ceases to be complied with.
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]

heading.en: Authorisation not to apply in certain cases

text.en:
5. The authorisation under paragraph 3 shall not apply to —
(a)any building or premises in the conservation areas as shown in the maps set out in the Second Schedule;
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]
(b)any part of a building or any premises which is specified to be used only for activity generating uses in the development control plans published by the competent authority from time to time pursuant to the provisions of the Written Statement to the Master Plan;
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]
(c)any building or premises in respect of which the competent authority has imposed any condition on the grant of any written permission under the Act or the repealed Act (whether before, on or after 23rd February 2011) expressly prohibiting —
(i)the use of the building or premises as a child care centre; or
(ii)any change in use without the prior permission of the competent authority; and
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]
(d)any building or any part thereof sold by or leased from the HDB for any commercial use.
[S 84/2011 wef 23/02/2011]
